verdict.rationale: Digits says its collaboration features let business owners and accountants review and share financials (digits-docs-11, digits-docs-9). Firm plans include "roles and permissions" and team seats (digits-supp-pricing), and the sandbox models an accounting-firm/client relationship (digits-supp-sandbox), which suggests accountants can be connected to a client's books. However, nothing documents a founder inviting an external accountant, and role-scoped permissions are only evidenced on the firm side. Missing for 10: a documented founder-side invite flow for an external accountant, role-scoped permission levels for invited users (review-only vs. edit/adjust), evidence that accountants can make adjustments rather than only review, and independent corroboration.
